recolored.why: The upstream body/belly contrast (luma 163 vs 216) is much flatter than the stock sprite ramp (palette 13 vs 1: luma 115 vs 224), so no single toon grade renders a mid-blue body with a white belly: the fitted grade turned the body white and the belly lavender (color loss floor ~1.04). Only the saturated body blue is deepened; belly, fins, orange parts, mouth and eyes are untouched.
recolored.weight: w = smoothstep(45, 75, max(r,g,b) - min(r,g,b)) * smoothstep(30, 60, b - r)
recolored.encode: WebP quality 92 (sharp); meshes re-encoded with Draco edgebreaker, quantizePosition 14
